sql.text: UPDATE "public"."Lock" SET "isLocked" = $1, "lockedBy" = $2, "lockedAt" = $3, "updatedAt" = $4 WHERE ("public"."Lock"."key" = $5 AND ("public"."Lock"."isLocked" = $6 OR ("public"."Lock"."isLocked" = $7 AND "public"."Lock"."lockedAt" IS NULL) OR ("public"."Lock"."isLocked" = $8 AND "public"."Lock"."lockedAt" < $9)))

SELECT "public"."blob"."id", "public"."blob"."createdAt", "public"."blob"."updatedAt", "public"."blob"."fileUrl", "public"."blob"."name", "public"."blob"."mimeType", "public"."blob"."size", "public"."blob"."sourceUrl", "public"."blob"."status"::text, "public"."blob"."eventId" FROM "public"."blob" WHERE "public"."blob"."status" = CAST($1::text AS "public"."BlobStatus") ORDER BY "public"."blob"."createdAt" ASC OFFSET $2
